entries.title: An assistant that runs on your Mac
entries.summary: A chat bubble in the sidebar answers questions about your disk, apps, startup items and memory, using Apple's on-device model and LickMyPaw's own read-only tools. Unsigned build, Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or later; the assistant needs macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence.
items: Assistant: ask what takes up space, what can be cleaned, which apps you no longer use, what starts at login or what uses memory
It reads sizes, names and dates only, never file contents, and cannot delete anything
Answers in the language you ask in. Without Apple Intelligence it explains why and links to System Settings
The sidebar no longer scrolls: icons shrink to fit the window
Updates tab matches Homebrew casks by the app they installed, not by name
Fixed in 0.2.1: double-clicking a bubble in Prowl on macOS 15 opened the wrong folder

entries.title: Menu bar, five new tools and self-update
entries.summary: The app feels like a real Mac app now. It also fixes a hang at launch that the first test builds showed. Unsigned build, Apple Silicon, macOS 13 or later.
items: Menu bar paw with free disk, memory pressure, CPU load and the Trash. Sampling runs only while it is open and costs microseconds
Launch at login and optional notifications for a full disk or a big Trash, off by default
Maintenance: flush DNS, reindex Spotlight, rebuild Launch Services, thin Time Machine snapshots. Each task shows its exact command first
Privacy cleaner for Safari, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc and Firefox. Everything goes to the Trash, so it can be undone
Shredder: overwrite then delete. It cannot be undone, and on SSD and APFS an overwrite is not guaranteed to reach the old blocks
Updates tab in Applications for Sparkle, App Store and Homebrew casks, only when you press the button
More Cleanup categories: Mail downloads, iOS backups, Simulator devices, Xcode DeviceSupport and Archives
Built-in update check against GitHub Releases, verified with SHA-256
Fixed: hang at launch with 100% CPU, window going behind others, update banner that would not close

entries.title: LickMyPaw has a website
entries.summary: The project now has a home outside the README. Release notes, roadmap updates and project news will be posted on this page.

entries.title: Fix: the packaged app crashed on launch
entries.summary: The app from the DMG or zip crashed because its resources were looked up in the build machine's path. They are now found inside the app. CI unpacks the packaged app and checks it before every release.

entries.title: First public build (do not use)
entries.summary: This build crashes on launch outside the machine that built it. Use v0.1.1 or later.
